name: Dubinn

attributes.attribute: obscure Irish goddess known through her descendant

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dubinn is an obscure Irish goddess. Her fame rests on a famous descendant. That descendant is Diarmait Ua Duibne. Diarmait ranks as Ireland’s most romantic hero. The goddess of that line earns a small place in the lore. Yet her name lives on through her kin. She stands among the older beings of the island. Scholars honor her through the tales of Diarmait. The romance of his deeds keeps her memory bright.
